_comment: Per-machine N-instance rig config for run_test4.ps1 (Milestone A gate, 4-process loopback). Copy to local.rig.json and fill in with this machine's real install paths - local.rig.json is gitignored and never committed. Element 0 of 'instances' MUST be the host; elements 1..N-1 are joins, launched in array order after the host reaches gameplay. run_test4.ps1 THROWS if fewer instances are configured than requested, or if any installDir is missing kenshi_x64.exe - it never silently degrades to fewer instances.

instances._comment: index 0 = HOST. Must be a real, loader-equipped Kenshi install (the primary Steam install or an equivalent clone).
index 1 = join1, launched after the host reaches 'gameplay started'.

index 2 = join2. disconnectAtSec/reconnectAtSec (both optional, seconds since this instance's own launch) drive the DoD's live disconnect/rejoin step: an instance with disconnectAtSec exits early while the others keep running; an instance with reconnectAtSec is (re)launched at that offset as the replacement/rejoin join. Leave both null for a plain 4-way connect with no lifecycle scripting.
